name: Word by word
summary: A sentence that reveals one word at a time, with the word being read highlighted in accent, for narration and subtitles.

params.name: at
params.note: start as a fraction of the shot (0..1)

params.note: start frame; overrides at when set

params.name: text
params.default: Every word lands on its own beat

params.name: size
params.note: font size; shrinks if the sentence runs long
